original_test_intent: Verify each approved BlueField-3 host-facing PCIe link trains at expected speed/width and every measured lane has adequate vendor-defined eye margin.
original_method: Pin NVQual BF3 EOM artifact/config; map DPU serial/BDF/slot to root port and lanes; capture DPU firmware/services/link/AER baseline; approve eye fields/units/limits and link effect; drain traffic; run bounded measurement; retain per-lane margins and restore link/services/health.
manual_activity: DPU/signal-integrity owner approves path/lane oracle and coordinates BF3 traffic/service isolation and recovery.
safety_requirements: Do not probe unmapped or live production paths
No invented margin units or command
agent_execution_scope: Collect lane/link/error and final service health
